Market today: The tech/chip sector faces headwinds. While some AI infrastructure shows resilience, the dominant theme is rising memory costs and dwindling cash for the AI buildout, creating a challenging environment.

Your holdings: SOXL (-54.92%) and SPAL (-60.95%) are leveraged and deeply underwater, with stops far past. QQQI (-5.97%) is also a SELL and below its stop. Margin amplifies these drops significantly.

Watch: Keep a close eye on memory costs and supply chain developments, as these are key drivers for your chip-heavy portfolio. Also, monitor how the broader AI buildout costs impact tech margins.

Bottom line: Prioritize aggressive risk management on your leveraged and underperforming positions, especially given your margin exposure.
plays: Cut losses on SOXL and SPAL. Their leveraged nature and deep losses (-54.92%, -60.95%) demand immediate attention, as current stops are ineffective.
Respect stops on QQQI and SMH. Trim QQQI below 52 and SMH at 540 to manage downside risk.
Consider MSFT as a new buy. Scanner shows an ACCUMULATE setup (entry 461.44-462.23, stop 459.31), aligning with AI buildout resilience.
